Subject: Attachment Upgrade Kits 

''Single-Swap Mechanic Suggestion''
Concept: Current weapon kits (Grey to Gold rarities) automatically assign attachments.
This removes the creative "Gunsmith" element. 

My suggestion: allow players one single swap per attachment category when upgrading.

How it works:

Auto-Equip: A kit adds standard attachments (e.g., Green kit adds a Thermal Optic and Long Barrel).
The Swap: In the inventory, the player can change these specific attachments once (e.g., swapping the Thermal for a Red Dot).

Locked Choice: Once swapped, the choice is locked. Higher tiers (Blue/Gold) allow for new swaps for the additional attachments provided.

Why this improves the game:
Retains Creativity
Balanced Agency
Increased Engagement

This would significantly increase my engagement with the game, as "building" the weapon is half the fun of the Call of Duty experience.

Look at BO3 — Der Eisendrache, Revelations, etc. You could feel Zombies immediately. It didn’t feel like multiplayer or Warzone at all; it felt like a unique mode that stood out.

The statistics on the stock band at the bottom are references:
- NOVA 1944.06 - 300:
-> Nova 6 gas, which began development in 1944. 300 could be a reference to all 300k victims during the Singapore incident in BO3.

- MASN 63.93 - 40:
-> Both Alex and David Mason, 63 is a reference to year 1963 when Alex broke out of Vorkuta, rescued Weaver, and killed JFK. 40 is a reference to Operation 40 which failed and led to his capture by Dragovich. Idk about 93, maybe it's his age when he makes an appearance in some of BO2's endings.

- RAUL 72.86 - 6.14:
-> Obviously Raul Menendez, 72 links to 1972 when Josefina got burnt, 86 is 1986 when he lost his eye to Mason and Josefina was killed by Woods. 6.14 either alludes to June 2014 when Cordie Die became active or June 14th, a date around when Woods told David about his dad's death.

- GILD 2025.11 - 20.35:
-> The Guild, 2025.11 may be a teaser that BO7 might be released in November 2025, and 20.35 is a reference to the game's setting in 2035.

However be aware those are only speculations and the story might end up being a nothingburger.
